item: A background job whose worker ends in SystemExit or KeyboardInterrupt now ends as an error instead of staying "running" forever
summary: BackgroundJob._run caught Exception only, so a worker ending in SystemExit (a library calling sys.exit) or KeyboardInterrupt left the job "running" for the life of the process: the task manager showed an active job that was gone and a writer job held db_writers_busy. A second clause sets the state to error with the exception class only (the words of a SystemExit are the caller's own and a job's kwargs can carry a passphrase), logs one WARNING naming the class, and re-raises. Red on main for both exceptions; mutants (no clause, words in the log, swallow instead of re-raise) each turn a test red. Rebased onto the failed-start bundle (#1687), which owns start().
